beranda.title: Home
beranda.description: COVID-19 records for Central Sulawesi and Indonesia, 2 March 2020 to 14 January 2024: cases, Rt, vaccination, hospital contacts and a home isolation guide.

beranda.provincesNote: By total positive cases. Central Sulawesi comes first.

beranda.callText: Call 119, the Ministry of Health emergency medical service.
beranda.callArchive: The other contacts on this site are an archive from the pandemic.
beranda.symptomsText: The most common symptoms: fever, cough, tiredness, and loss of taste or smell. Shortness of breath is a serious sign. Some people have no symptoms.
beranda.riskText: COVID-19 is a disease caused by the SARS-CoV-2 virus. Its symptoms look like a common flu, but it is deadlier. The virus passes quickly from person to person, even from people with no symptoms.
beranda.riskAsk: Do you have symptoms? Read the home isolation guide to know what to do.
beranda.protectIntro: The best way not to be infected is to avoid exposure to the virus.
beranda.protectLead: COVID-19 spreads from person to person through small droplets when coughing or sneezing. What we can all do:

check.wash: Wash your hands often with soap, or use hand sanitizer
check.face: Avoid touching your face, especially nose, mouth and eyes
check.clean: Clean surfaces that many people touch
check.distancing: Physical distancing: reduce physical contact with others
check.meter: Keep 1 to 3 metres from other people
check.home: Stay at home and avoid public places when you do not need to go
check.mask: Wear a mask when you must go out or meet others

beranda.tipWash: Wash your hands with soap and water.
beranda.tipMask: Wear a mask when sick or in public places.

beranda.socialText: Follow the latest COVID-19 news for Central Sulawesi on the social channels of Sulteng Lawan COVID.
beranda.aboutText: COVID-19 is an infectious disease caused by the SARS-CoV-2 virus. It spreads through breath droplets and touching contaminated surfaces.

app.title: Android app
app.text: PICO Sulteng for Android has the same figures, curves and contacts on your phone.
app.download: Download the APK from GitHub Releases
app.step1: Open the GitHub Releases page on an Android phone and download the newest APK file.
app.step2: Open the downloaded file. If asked, allow installs from your browser or file manager.
app.step3: Follow the install prompts. Afterwards, switch that permission off again.
app.warn: This APK is installed outside an app store, so Android does not vet it. Download it only from the official link on this page. The app shows archive data. iPhone is not supported yet.
